notes.title: Breaking News: "Kill the Twister" has received a patch
notes.notes:
Update Alert: a patch has been reported in the local region
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508839/a4c6957d5c89e1397702cf2d84a477f5b1d57b89.png
Citizens have reported a number of small changes affecting weather patterns and user interaction in nearby games. Reported changes include:

 Tornado attacks are slightly more spaced out
 Whirls appear in smaller groups
 Moving while zoomed in will cancel the zoom
 Tutorial text lingers a bit longer
 Most recent tutorials and objectives are now displayed in the pause menu
 Added a "Very Easy" mode for those seeking a more chill experience
 Added a "Very Hard" mode for those seeking pain
 [spoiler]Added an arrow indicator to better warn the player of incoming meteors [/spoiler]
 [spoiler]Made it so meteor cant kill you when you have the bazooka[/spoiler] 
 Fixed the shotgun not firing the first time you click after picking it up


Local advisory boards recommend immediate replays to ensure quality control. Further updates to be expected in the coming days.

Stay safe out there folks,
-Channel 27 News
